label: Whatever has the nine is IMMENSE_2, by unfolding the nine
description: Let g have the nine. g is INFINITE_1 (one of the nine). Its supreme goodness includes causing every perfection of every other being, so in particular the being of every other being in act as to being: g is creator of all (contained by definition, not independently derived). Hence g is IMMENSE_2. A definitional unfolding with no premise; the conclusion is IMMENSE_2, not IMMENSE_1.
